summary: Phase 10 (Operating Hours & Holiday Management) end-to-end testing. 18/18 backend tests passed (new /store/status fields, pause with body, special-hours CRUD+upsert-by-date, advance-orders PATCH + clamp, holiday message in status, overview w/ conflict detection, auth guards). Frontend AdminHours page fully verified: all required data-testid selectors present; pause dialog → reason+ETA persisted and resume works; holiday add/delete; special-hours add/delete; advance-orders update; 7-row overview renders. ClosedOverlay code paths reviewed (holiday-message, pause-reason, pause-until, conditional order-later-btn based on accept_advance_orders).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/store.py: in /store/status next_open loop, 'await db...to_list(1) or []' will short-circuit wrongly because 'await' returns the list first, then 'or []' evaluates the list — fine, but the generator-next trick is brittle; consider 'sp = (docs[0] if docs else None)' for clarity.

Overview conflict detection only flags delivery vs pickup/dine_in; no conflict signalled when a service is enabled with start>=close on non-overnight configs. OK for MVP since backend treats close<=open as overnight.
AdminHours.js ~650 lines — getting near the 700-line guideline. Consider extracting PauseCard/PauseDialog/WeeklyGrid/HolidaysSection/SpecialHoursSection/AdvanceOrdersCard into separate files.

PauseDialog generates ETA ISO via `new Date("YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:00").toISOString()` which treats the input as local time — acceptable UX, but note this differs from the admin's timezone if session is elsewhere.
seed_data_creation: Test fixtures teardown restores Monday delivery to 10:00-22:00, unpauses ordering, resets advance-orders to {true, 7}, and removes any TEST_-prefixed holidays/specials. Confirmed clean state after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 10 hours+holiday mgmt fully validated. test_hours_phase10.py covers all new endpoints. AdminHours UI selectors match spec exactly (hours-row-{day}, {svc}-open/close/open-toggle-{day}, apply-all-{svc}, overview-row-{date}, overview-conflict/holiday/special-{date}, holiday-row/delete-{id}, special-row/delete-{id}, accept-advance-switch, advance-days-input, advance-save-btn, pause-card/pause-dialog/pause-reason-input/pause-eta-date/pause-eta-time/pause-confirm-btn/resume-ordering-btn). ClosedOverlay exposes holiday-message, pause-reason, pause-until, order-later-btn (hidden when accept_advance_orders=false).
